mapper.sql: id, username, email, display_name AS displayName, status, auth_source AS authSource, mfa_required AS mfaRequired, authz_version AS authzVersion, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, password_hash AS passwordHash, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform.platform_user ORDER BY username
SELECT r.name FROM platform.platform_user_role ur JOIN platform.platform_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.platform_user_id = #{userId}::uuid
SELECT ur.platform_user_id AS platformUserId, r.name AS roleName FROM platform.platform_user_role ur JOIN platform.platform_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id ORDER BY ur.platform_user_id, r.name

INSERT INTO platform.platform_user (username, email, display_name, status, auth_source, password_hash, mfa_required, authz_version) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{displayName}, 'ACTIVE', #{authSource}::platform.auth_source, #{passwordHash}, #{mfaRequired}, 1) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.platform_user SET email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), mfa_required = COALESCE(#{mfaRequired}, mfa_required), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{userId}::uuid
UPDATE platform.platform_user SET status = #{status}::platform.user_status, updated_at = now(), authz_version = authz_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId}::uuid
UPDATE platform.platform_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = now(), authz_version = authz_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.platform_user_role (platform_user_id, role_id, granted_by) SELECT #{userId}::uuid, r.id, #{grantedBy}::uuid FROM platform.platform_role r WHERE r.name = #{roleName} ON CONFLICT (platform_user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM platform.platform_user_role ur USING platform.platform_role r WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.platform_user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND r.name = #{roleName}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.platform_user SET authz_version = authz_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{userId}::uuid
